summary: Missing critical fixture files (fixtures/minor.commits.log, fixtures/patch.commits.log, fixtures/major.commits.log), package.json, and .actrc—run-act-tests.sh will fail at line `cp "$PROJECT_DIR/fixtures/$fixture"`. Workflow 'Run unit tests' step will fail (test/bumper.test.js missing; out of scope but blocks execution). Code present (bumper.js, cli.js) shows solid design: pure functions, descriptive errors, proper output handling. Workflow YAML is well-structured (pinned refs, least-privilege, step IDs). But deliverable is non-functional without data fixtures. `--pull=false` in run-act-tests.sh is risky if image not locally cached.
